use.flag: Build applications (clamscan, clamd, clamdscan, clamonacc (also has its own USE flag), sigtool, clambc, clamav-milter (also requires milter USE flag), clamdtop, clamsubmit, clamconf).
Bypass building of libfreshclam and the ClamAV CLI applications.
Use dev-libs/libmspack instead of the version bundled with ClamAV
